scope: Synthetic local PostgreSQL query microbenchmark. Repeated warm/server-first-touch observations, not deployed latency or a production p95 guarantee.

configuration.paired_order: Rotating variant order with alternating reversal; each variant appears in each position
configuration.autovacuum: Disabled only on disposable fixture tables for stable tuple/WAL comparisons
configuration.cache_scope: No shared-buffer or OS-cache flush. First-touch follows population and is not disk-cold.
configuration.fixture: 80% unique cache keys, 20% multi-row journal keys; 256-character synthetic payload padding; realistic composite, expiry and pending indexes

four_workers_same_key.scope: Real rejected UPSERT round trips without a JavaScript negative cache; includes local IPC and row-lock contention.

four_workers_distinct_keys.scope: Real rejected UPSERT round trips without a JavaScript negative cache; includes local IPC and row-lock contention.
